notes.title: Tutorial Island Update!
notes.notes:
[b]July 3rd Patch Notes[/b]

This update includes a ton of fixes and new recipes to craft. In the long run the demo will be offline only but right now the demo has a server for people to test it out and try things out. 
Working on a basic tutorial that has been implemented when you start your character and walk outside. Also great news. We hit over 200 wish lists!

Alot of the bug fixes are thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/StelloHexis]Stello Hexis[/url]
Bug Fixes
Fixed bug for bonus stats 
Fixed tab issue for account login screen
Fixed tutorial ui
Fixed player damage issue


Additions
New Recipes
Updated Island to have more builds. Thanks to Wilson on this.
Added new items and new models
Add placeholder icons on some items and some new icons overall

Just a reminder. 
I am just a solo developer. I do hire out and am quite slow overall due to working but always trying to get time in while trying to maintain regular life.

Upcoming additions will be more for the main game in which I am still planning on getting out this month.
I am currently looking for UI artist. This is a paid position.

Don't forget to join the [url=https://discord.gg/2bW9kaMDrQ]discord[/url]!

notes.title: The Demo has been released!
notes.notes:
This is a huge milestone for the game. The demo is online only at the moment so you can log into the server after you type your username and password.
If you have any bugs please report them in the [url=https://discord.gg/2bW9kaMDrQ]discord[/url] or post in the steam community board. 
The server should handle about 20-30 on all at the same time. For the main game, I'm working with two people. One a coder and one a level designer but might become a coder as well to help progress the game. I work full time so progress is super slow overall but I am always working on the game be it small things or just working on what I can fit in for the day.

The demo isn't final but it is for players to try the game and support it later down the road.



[b]Features added[/b]
Fishing - Fishing requires a fishing pole in your hands to fish
Furnace - the furnace area is where the blacksmith is in the back of the pirate town to make higher end items
Basic tutorial NPC added in each town

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Items weren't showing prices when selecting them.
Crafting wasn't properly showing
Skills and experience weren't saving onto the server properly
NPC Dialog was popping up before logging in
Fishing wasn't properly working when you tried to walk away from the fishing area
Male and Female characters weren't doing damage to each other
Underwater sounds were start if you walked into the ocean
Character movement was happening when typing
Furnace was kicking players when attacking it
Audio wasn't saving in the profile
Female character was being kicked from sailing the ship
Wood wasn't properly showing when cutting a tree down
Ships were desyncing when a higher latency player would be on board
Underwater creatures weren't properly floating around
Going into first person would hide underwater layer
Minimap wasn't properly syncing to the player
Dying wasn't showing the respawn countdown.
Animation fixes


Known Bugs and Issues
Stats are not giving the bonus for being healthy
Meaning stats are above 90% don't get the bonus
The options menu isn't finalized
Sometimes the punches play two audio sounds
